$comment: Seeded rule-stratified random sample of distinct onsystem corpus findings, unlabelled. Each item: where the finding is (repo, pinned commit, file, line, column), the rule id, the finding message exactly as onsystem printed it, the matched source text, and ~15 lines of code from the pinned checkout (the reported line is marked with >). No suggested fix and no labels. run, occurrence and fingerprint are the corpus keys (scripts/corpus-lib.ts) for adding labels to corpus/labels.json. LABELLED: each finding carries label (TP / FP / debatable), own_ds_value, replacement_wrong, reason and looked_at, added by a blind AI reviewer (claude-opus-5-5 as a Claude Code agent); see LABELLER.md.
